one_line: Cloud-based work management and collaboration platform with a REST API for programmatically managing sheets, rows, reports, and automation.
auth_notes: OAuth2 (client credentials + user scope authorization) for user-authorized app access; also supports Personal Access Tokens (PAT) / API access tokens for server-to-server use. App registration required via the Smartsheet developer portal.
self_serve_notes: No free plan — Smartsheet requires a paid plan (30-day free trial available). Once on a plan, developers can create API tokens or register an OAuth app in the developer portal without manual approval.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints covering sheets, rows, columns, cells, reports, dashboards/sights, workspaces, folders, users, groups, automation rules, and events/webhooks.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported; subscription to sheet/row/cell events with HMAC-signed payloads.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers for Smartsheet exist (e.g. community-built smartsheet-mcp); no confirmed official MCP.

evidence.note: Fetched text was empty (JS shell); confirmed docs endpoint reachable via curl and used domain knowledge of Smartsheet API.

agent_notes: Auth method (OAuth2 + PAT) and paid-only model well established; endpoint breadth from knowledge, not fetched text.
